notes.title: OFFICIAL: RELEASE DATE IS SEPT 23
notes.notes:
We got all approval from Steam & we are STOKED to have this game come out! 

DeV0LVE will be hosting a live stream of the first 3 levels of the game for promotion @ Twitch the morning of release @ 10:30 MST. If you miss the stream it will be available shorty after on YouTube 

-S.S.

notes.title: AWAITING RELEASE APPROVAL
notes.notes:
Heyo,

Salty Sloth here to let you know that we are awaiting Steam's approval for our game build! Once that is done. BOOM -- Take it, it's available. 

L8's

-SS


*UPDATE*

Our planned release of Sept 19 has been changed to Sept 23 due to waiting on Steam to review our game for approval. We believe that it should be done by this Friday for sure as it shouldn't take more than 3-5 business days yo!

Thanks for your support & we apologize for the delays yo!

-S.S.
